recipes.title: Braised Bok Choy with Dual Eggs in Broth (上湯金銀蛋浸白菜)
recipes.description: 上湯金銀蛋浸白菜 - bok choy poached in broth with salted and century egg.
ingredients: Dried prawns (or chicken broth), a good handful
steps: Prep: wash the bok choy; cube the century egg; separate the salted egg yolk and white (chop the yolk, lightly beat the white); slice the ginger.
Sear: heat oil in a deep pan and stir-fry the ginger and dried prawns until fragrant; add the salted egg yolk and century egg, sautéing ~1 minute until the yolk begins to foam.
Broth: pour in the boiling water to create a milky broth; season with chicken powder (or salt) and white pepper.
Simmer: add the bok choy, cover, and cook 2-3 minutes until tender.
Finish: turn off the heat, drizzle the salted egg white over the top, let it set a few seconds, gently stir, and serve.

recipes.title: Gochujang cabbage
recipes.description: Buttered gochujang cabbage. (The original saved only the ingredient list; the method below is a suggested standard preparation.)
ingredients: 1 generous tsp gochujang paste (more for spicier)
steps: Melt the butter with the gochujang and water in a pan to make a sauce.
Add the cabbage and cook, covered, until tender, tossing to coat.
Garnish with toasted sesame.

recipes.title: Mash potato
ingredients: 1/2-3/4 cup heavy cream or whole milk
steps: Cut the potatoes and boil in salted water until fork-tender.
Drain, then add the butter and warm cream.
Mash until smooth and season.
Tip: don't overmix.

recipes.title: Miso creamy cabbage
recipes.description: Roasted cabbage with creamy miso mushrooms.
ingredients: 8 green cabbage wedges (~1 3/4" thick, core intact; half a head)
1 lb (450g) mixed mushrooms (enoki, shimeji, beech, oyster, shiitake, cremini, etc.)
2 tbsp white or yellow miso paste
steps: Prep: preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment (one for mushrooms, one for cabbage).
Roast the mushrooms: spread on a sheet, toss with neutral oil only (no seasoning), and set aside.
Cabbage (oven): place the wedges on the second sheet, drizzle generously with oil, and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Roast, timing both trays to finish together: cabbage 25-30 minutes flipping halfway (until the edges are charred and the center is tender); mushrooms 20 minutes tossing once (edges lightly seared).

Stovetop alternative for cabbage: heat a large skillet on medium to medium-high, add oil and 4 wedges, add 1/4 cup water, cover and steam 4 minutes until the water evaporates, then sear uncovered until golden, flip and sear the other side; repeat with the rest.

Make the sauce: over medium-low, sauté the butter and garlic a few seconds until lightly golden; add the water and miso and whisk smooth; add the cream and soy sauce; bring to a gentle simmer (don't hard-boil); toss the roasted mushrooms in to coat.
Assemble: place the cabbage on a plate, spoon the creamy miso mushrooms on top, and garnish with chives.
Notes: the mushrooms and cabbage can be made ahead; slightly undercooking prevents over-softening when reheating.
